title: CORE State Watcher Registration v1
description: Schema for a domain-neutral state watcher registration. CORE defines the schema; downstream forks provide the values.

watcher_id.description: Unique identifier within the fork namespace.

operator.description: Comparison operator for the watch condition.

operand_schema.description: Schema path for the observed value.

threshold_schema.description: Schema path for the threshold or reference value.

event_type.description: Business event type to emit when condition is met.

profile_id.description: Execution profile under which this watcher is active.

threshold_value.description: Scalar threshold value for gt/gte/lt/lte operators.

cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive events from this watcher.
